description: This PHP class defines a plugin component for the Revive Adserver, specifically handling log processing for click country data within the openXDeliveryLogCountry plugin. It includes methods for retrieving dependency information, bucket table details, and statistics migration mappings.

classes.name: Plugins_DeliveryLog_OxLogCountry_LogClickCountry
classes.description: A plugin class for handling click country log data, providing methods for dependency management, bucket and statistics table info, and data migration mapping.

methods.name: getDependencies
methods.description: Returns dependencies for the plugin component, including related data preparation components.

methods.name: getBucketName
methods.description: Returns the name of the bucket table used for storing raw log data.

methods.name: getBucketTableColumns
methods.description: Returns the columns and their types for the bucket table.

methods.name: getStatisticsName
methods.description: Returns the name of the statistics table for aggregated data.

methods.name: getStatisticsMigration
methods.description: Provides the mapping configuration for migrating bucket data into statistics tables.
